feature: Business capability hypotheses and workflow mapping
implementation_steps: Document reusable commerce capability map and hypothetical primary/alternate workflows across stock-tracked trade, branch sales, social/manual/POS channels, purchasing, collections and return; annotate unsupported sectors; create synthetic actor/process swimlanes and future discovery questions. No interviews are asserted.
contracts_data_ui: Produce workflow map, actor matrix, exception examples, screen list; no code.
security_reliability_scalability: Do not assume any sector-specific regulation, tax, fulfilment method, business hours or customer policy; use only fictional data and explicitly label hypotheses.
acceptance_evidence: Product/architecture reviewers approve labeled hypotheses, actor/process maps, validation backlog and business-capability boundaries. External merchant validation explicitly PENDING.

implementation_steps: Map ownership of Catalog, Inventory, Order, Payment, Return, SaaS Billing and HR; define legal commands/events and prohibited direct table writes; register ADRs.
contracts_data_ui: Produce context map, bounded-context interfaces, dependency rules; sample payloads.
security_reliability_scalability: Test ownership logic against refund, dispatch, reservation expiry and subscription billing; reject circular dependencies.
acceptance_evidence: Architect review approves domain ownership and integration sequence.

implementation_steps: Define states, commands, actors, transitions, failure paths and compensation for order/payment/fulfilment/shipment/RMA/reservation/PO/subscription.
contracts_data_ui: State diagrams, transition tables, idempotency policy, source-of-truth mapping.
security_reliability_scalability: Model duplicate, out-of-order, concurrent cancellation, partial receipt, RTO and disputes before schema implementation.
acceptance_evidence: Model-based test cases and impossible-state checklist signed.

implementation_steps: Identify trust boundaries for owner, employee, cashier, operator, API key and worker; enumerate object/action/field rights by branch/tenant; plan privacy and retention.
contracts_data_ui: Permission workbook, attack tree, security risk register, data classification.
security_reliability_scalability: Include IDOR/BOLA, file-link leakage, forged webhook, cross-tenant FK, role escalation and compromised support access.
acceptance_evidence: Security reviewer approves matrix and explicit deny tests.

implementation_steps: Assign accountable owner/due-before-milestone for each gate; capture default policy and blocked capability; get GST, payment and payroll validation paths.
contracts_data_ui: `DECISIONS_LOG.md`, ADR template and feature approval checklist.
security_reliability_scalability: Never allow coding agent to substitute a GST rate, merchant plan price, OTP provider or payment evidence policy.
acceptance_evidence: RG0 list shows APPROVED or BLOCKED per gated decision.

implementation_steps: Create two-tenant fixtures, declared hypothetical SKU/order workload profiles and retry matrix; define performance/load environment; establish synthetic UAT scenario ownership and operational staffing.
contracts_data_ui: Test suite map SC-01…SC-12, baseline SLO worksheet, metrics catalog.
security_reliability_scalability: Treat v3 response-time, load and RPO/RTO numbers as targets requiring measured conditions, not guaranteed production KPIs.
acceptance_evidence: RG0 includes test data design, workload plan and reviewer assignments.

implementation_steps: Initialize pnpm/Turborepo with independent app builds; set TypeScript strict mode; create API/worker/web/mobile/POS/admin shells and shared typed packages; add CODEOWNERS.
contracts_data_ui: Scaffold repository and package dependency graph; no working storefront code.
security_reliability_scalability: Add lint rule forbidding cross-module private imports and circular dependencies; lock dependency versions.
acceptance_evidence: Fresh checkout installs and runs typed builds with no secrets.

implementation_steps: Build reproducible Docker Compose for API, PostgreSQL, Redis and object-storage stub; seed Tenant A/B; script reset/reseed; staging deploy documentation.
contracts_data_ui: `.env.example`, docker profiles, isolated test DB and migrations command.
security_reliability_scalability: No real PII or secrets in fixtures, no production DB connectivity from local tests; readiness and health endpoints.
acceptance_evidence: One command boots local environment; API and queue smoke tests pass.

feature: HTTP contract, validation and API client
implementation_steps: Define `/api/v1`, DTO validation, structured errors, X-Request-Id, cursor pagination, ETag/version, idempotency header; generate OpenAPI and TS clients.
contracts_data_ui: Shared `api-contracts` and `api-client`; global guards/interceptors/exception filters.
security_reliability_scalability: Reject unknown privileged fields (mass assignment); max payload/timeout; schema diff check in CI.
acceptance_evidence: Contract tests prove errors, retries, pagination and backwards compatibility.

implementation_steps: Establish Prisma migration strategy, UUID/timestamps/concurrency pattern, decimal/money primitives, transactional command wrapper and tenant-safe FK examples.
contracts_data_ui: Migration runner, seed scripts, schema checks, transaction retry utility.
security_reliability_scalability: Index tenant/branch access; test lock contention, deadlocks and rollback; no generic unsafe repository finder.
acceptance_evidence: CI applies all migrations to empty DB and validates repeatable rollback plan.

feature: Tenant and branch execution context plumbing
implementation_steps: Define signed/verified principal context injectable in HTTP and jobs; put tenant/branch scope behind repository filters; deny queries lacking context; enforce composed authorization.
contracts_data_ui: AuthContext/RequestContext types; guard and query policy; audit metadata propagation.
security_reliability_scalability: Cross-tenant guessed IDs and worker context leaks must be impossible; platform operations use distinct trust boundary.
acceptance_evidence: Tenant A/B isolation smoke test prevents any cross-tenant read/write.

implementation_steps: Implement business transaction + outbox insert atomically; dispatcher polls/locks outbox; consumer inbox dedupe; retries/backoff/DLQ; operator-safe replay path.
contracts_data_ui: `outbox_events`, `inbox_dedupes`, job log and worker dashboards; sample event.
security_reliability_scalability: Crash after commit, repeated delivery and bad payload cannot double-effect; record schema/event versions and key ordering.
acceptance_evidence: Simulated crash/replay produces exactly one consumer side effect per event semantics.

feature: Authentication, secrets and protected configuration base
implementation_steps: Wire an auth-provider adapter, secret-store interface and environment validation; enforce safe cookie/token choices, CSRF and secure headers appropriate to transport.
contracts_data_ui: Provider-neutral auth interface, secret refs, log redaction and config loader.
security_reliability_scalability: Rotate test keys; fail closed without configured secret; do not hardcode SMS or security provider.
acceptance_evidence: CI secret scan, session security smoke and rotation simulation.

feature: File object and background jobs infrastructure
implementation_steps: Design authorized upload intents, object metadata, private storage, expiring signed download URLs and async scan/resize hooks; status/cancel endpoints for long tasks.
contracts_data_ui: `file_objects`, storage adapter, job progress API.
security_reliability_scalability: Validate MIME/content, size, ownership, filenames, malware scanning and tenant-safe signed URLs; bound uploads/egress.
acceptance_evidence: Cross-tenant file denial and expired URL tests pass.

feature: CI/CD, supply chain and feature flags
implementation_steps: Add lint/typecheck/unit/integration/contract jobs, dependency scans, SAST, build image, provenance and safe staging deployment; flag control with audit/rollout cohort.
contracts_data_ui: CI matrix, release artifact, migration job and flag evaluation contract.
security_reliability_scalability: No prod deploy on failing guard; stage schema backward-compatible and rollback drill documented.
acceptance_evidence: Build→staging deploy→smoke→rollback demonstrated.

implementation_steps: Instrument HTTP, Prisma/DB, Redis/jobs, domain event and API errors; define redacted structured logging; dashboards, SLO proposals and incident owners.
contracts_data_ui: OTEL instrumentation, `/health`, `/ready`, alert routing and runbooks.
security_reliability_scalability: Avoid raw auth tokens, passwords, PII, bank refs in logs; cardinality budgets by tenant; alert thresholds based on observed data.
acceptance_evidence: Failed queue/DB scenarios appear in metrics and can be traced to owner.

feature: Owner registration, login and account recovery
implementation_steps: Implement chosen verified identity flow, login/logout/refresh, rate limits, locked-account recovery, privileged MFA and session revocation.
contracts_data_ui: User/identity/session tables, auth endpoints and responsive auth views.
security_reliability_scalability: No account enumeration, OTP guessing, insecure refresh reuse or persistent bearer tokens in localStorage.
acceptance_evidence: Owner verification and revoked-session replay tests pass.

implementation_steps: Add draft tenant creation, verified owner membership, tenant switch and membership status; server derives context from current verified membership.
contracts_data_ui: `tenants`, `memberships`, `/me/memberships`, `POST /tenants`.
security_reliability_scalability: Actor with two synthetic tenants cannot leak data across selected context or reuse URL tenant IDs.
acceptance_evidence: Tenant A/B switch preserves strict isolation across API, caches and jobs.

implementation_steps: Create first and additional branch, warehouse/location and optional register; constrain default branch and cross-branch grants.
contracts_data_ui: Branch/location entities and settings screens; scoped CRUD.
security_reliability_scalability: Prevent attaching location of Tenant B, deleting branch with active business references, unauthorized cross-branch transfers.
acceptance_evidence: Cashier sees own branch; owner can manage branch under plan entitlement.

implementation_steps: Implement role templates, action/resource/scope checks, branch grants, approval limits, protected superuser permissions and no privilege escalation on assignment.
contracts_data_ui: Roles/grants/membership tables, `/me/permissions`, role UI.
security_reliability_scalability: Server denies forbidden fields and nested relations, not only hidden UI; audit role changes and self-elevation.
acceptance_evidence: Full actor x action x branch matrix runs in integration tests.

feature: Business identity, legal profile and settings versioning
implementation_steps: Add business name, addresses, locale/timezone, tax posture flags, bank instructions, invoice/payment preferences and effective-dated config history.
contracts_data_ui: Config version tables, settings routes, validation and audit diff UI.
security_reliability_scalability: Enforce sensitive field masking, maker-checker where required and immutable historical policy snapshots.
acceptance_evidence: Config change impacts future documents without rewriting history.

implementation_steps: Build server-backed progress state with 10 v3 steps, prerequisites, save/resume/skip optional, readiness validation and authorized activation.
contracts_data_ui: `onboarding_flows/steps`, `/onboarding/*`, desktop/mobile friendly screens.
security_reliability_scalability: Prevent public exposure of draft tenant; block activation for mandatory payment/invoice/stock gaps but do not force future channels.
acceptance_evidence: SC-01 passes across logout, rejected import and go-live validation.

feature: Import Center: mapping and dry run
implementation_steps: Support CSV/XLSX safe ingestion, column mapping, row validation, duplicate SKU detection, dry-run preview and rejected-row download for products/variants/stock/customers/suppliers.
contracts_data_ui: `import_jobs/rows/mappings` and staged files, async preview API.
security_reliability_scalability: File quarantine, formula injection protection on CSV export, encoding controls, per-tenant quotas and memory bounds.
acceptance_evidence: 10k-row import preview tested with malformed, duplicate and cross-tenant references.

feature: Import commit, idempotency and opening balances
implementation_steps: Implement chunked commit with row provenance, resumable jobs, explicit partial acceptance, opening stock ledger command and safe compensation where already referenced.
contracts_data_ui: Import worker, commit endpoint, import row statuses, opening movement/source key.
security_reliability_scalability: Replayed import cannot create duplicate SKUs or double-count stock; rollback forbidden for referenced financial records.
acceptance_evidence: SC-01 import behavior and import replay/partial failures pass.

implementation_steps: Invite staff, link employee record to optional identity, assign branches/roles and revoke access; preserve historic order attribution after termination.
contracts_data_ui: Invites, employees, branch assignments and role UI.
security_reliability_scalability: Invite expiry/reuse, stolen link, revoked sessions, salary fields hidden from cashier.
acceptance_evidence: Staff can operate permitted branch after invite and loses access on revocation.

implementation_steps: Capture actor, reason, before/after safe diff, request ID and related business document for all sensitive settings/roles/stock/payment operations; build scoped viewer.
contracts_data_ui: Append-only `audit_logs`, `/audit-logs`, filter/export.
security_reliability_scalability: Redact bank/secrets/payroll, immutable writes, support access by explicit grant, secured export URLs.
acceptance_evidence: Tampering attempt denied; each privileged change traceable to actor and time.

feature: Merchant data export and privacy controls skeleton
implementation_steps: Define export authorization, subject-rights workflow, retention classes and business deletion/suspension policy; generate permissioned baseline export job.
contracts_data_ui: `report_jobs/audit_exports`, structured CSV/JSON and download status.
security_reliability_scalability: PII in downloads encrypted/short-lived; test deletion request versus legal retention hold.
acceptance_evidence: Owner exports own data; Tenant B cannot access output; policy gates recorded.

implementation_steps: Model merchant-defined hierarchical categories and typed attributes/units for stocked items; reserve but do not fake non-stock/service item behavior; no mandatory sector templates. Govern capability policy at G-02/G-15.
contracts_data_ui: Category/attribute schema, validation API and admin UI.
security_reliability_scalability: Prevent category loops, unauthorized edits and unsafe HTML; index parent/path and tenant.
acceptance_evidence: Two different merchant taxonomies coexist and export without interference.

implementation_steps: Add product draft→active→archived, variants, unique normalized SKU, tags, search filters, historical archival protections and one-piece stock setting.
contracts_data_ui: Products/variants tables and list/detail/create/edit APIs.
security_reliability_scalability: Enforce `(tenant_id, normalized_sku)` uniqueness at DB layer and optimistic version to prevent concurrent SKU collisions.
acceptance_evidence: Parallel SKU creation returns conflict; archived product remains visible in historic order snapshot.

implementation_steps: Implement upload intent, scan, resize, alt text and stable media references; build indexed product search and cursor pagination.
contracts_data_ui: File storage adapter, media entities, product search endpoints.
security_reliability_scalability: Strip unsafe metadata, signed URLs, enforce ownership, prevent SSRF via external image imports.
acceptance_evidence: Large catalog search/load and tenant-safe image access validated.

feature: Pricing, tax display and discount controls
implementation_steps: Store price schedules, optional branch/channel price book, tax-inclusive flag, price version and cost snapshot; implement server pricing evaluator with explicit rounding/discount ordering.
contracts_data_ui: Price tables, pricing service/preview API and price-edit UI.
security_reliability_scalability: No client-enforced discount limits or altered price in order; preserve historic price; audited privileged override.
acceptance_evidence: Quote and later confirmed order price match current policy or show explicit price-change conflict.

implementation_steps: Add append-only movement journal, per-SKU/location balance projection, authorized opening/receipt/issue/adjustment command, reconciliation math and audit.
contracts_data_ui: `stock_movements`, `stock_balances`, command endpoints and read grids.
security_reliability_scalability: Transactional balance update with movement source uniqueness; tenant-safe FK and short lock.
acceptance_evidence: Journal replay matches balances and corrections cannot directly edit old movements.

implementation_steps: Reserve available SKU in DB transaction; release/consume/expire with unique business source, TTL and separate on-hand/held calculations; use DB locking or proven atomic CAS.
contracts_data_ui: Reservations, stock availability API and expiry job; conflict/status UI.
security_reliability_scalability: 50 concurrent reservations for one unit yield one winner; retries, cancel/convert race and worker crash not oversell.
acceptance_evidence: INV-AC1/2 and SC-02 pass with ledger reconciliation.

implementation_steps: Implement reason-coded correction, damaged/write-off/quarantine disposition, approval threshold and compensating movement.
contracts_data_ui: Adjustment requests/approvals, quarantine stock and stock journal UI.
security_reliability_scalability: Maker-checker for large write-offs, no direct balance writes, strict stock-visibility policy.
acceptance_evidence: Damaged restock never changes sellable count; approved correction auditable.

implementation_steps: Capture count session, expected snapshot, blind count, discrepancy summary, supervisor approval, approved journal corrections; support partial session resume.
contracts_data_ui: Count/countLine entities, count endpoints, tablet UI.
security_reliability_scalability: Prevent stale count overwriting later sale; serialize/post variance with expected version and reassessment.
acceptance_evidence: Count differences reconcile without losing intervening movements.

implementation_steps: Implement request/approval/pick/dispatch/in-transit/partial receipt/cancel/exception workflow; record both movement legs at agreed business transition.
contracts_data_ui: Transfers/lines and transfer commands, stock in transit dashboard.
security_reliability_scalability: Never expose source inventory after dispatch or destination availability before receipt; tenant/branch permissions checked both sides.
acceptance_evidence: INV-AC4 plus partial/damaged transit test passes.

feature: Low-stock settings and stock reconciliation worker
implementation_steps: Build per-location thresholds, low stock query, ledger-vs-balance audit job, drift alerts and authorized investigation workflow.
contracts_data_ui: Thresholds/read models, scheduled verifier and alert metrics.
security_reliability_scalability: Index location/SKU and bound job page size; do not silently repair drift; route reconciliation incidents to operator.
acceptance_evidence: Intentional projection corruption detected, quarantined and explained.

implementation_steps: Add supplier identity, contacts, branch links, optional tax identifiers, lead time, payment terms, status and notes; support lookup and export.
contracts_data_ui: Supplier table, CRUD/search, vendor view.
security_reliability_scalability: Tenant-safe contact records, sensitive bank field masking, duplicate-warning not silent cross-supplier merge.
acceptance_evidence: Supplier from Tenant A never appears in Tenant B purchase lookup.

feature: Purchase order drafting, approval and lifecycle
implementation_steps: Draft PO lines, unit cost, tax snapshots, expected date and shipping; approve with amount/role policy; support revision, partial and final closure.
contracts_data_ui: `purchase_orders/po_lines`, command APIs, printable PO, timeline.
security_reliability_scalability: Optimistic version, no receiving against unapproved PO, maker-checker for thresholds, immutable approved item history or explicit revision.
acceptance_evidence: PO transitions tested and duplicate approve cannot generate extra commitment.

implementation_steps: Receive quantities partially, record accepted/rejected/damaged, lot/location/cost, supplier evidence and GRN; post accepted inventory atomically.
contracts_data_ui: `goods_receipts/receipt_lines`, stock receipt movement, API and mobile scanning UI.
security_reliability_scalability: Concurrent receipts cannot exceed remaining PO qty; retry never double posts; quarantine rejected stock.
acceptance_evidence: SC-05 6+4 receiving, 1 damaged and backorder reconciliation pass.

implementation_steps: Capture supplier reference, PO-GRN-bill difference, due date and draft payable; keep formal settlement and landed-cost allocation behind P1 gate if not yet approved.
contracts_data_ui: Supplier bill and discrepancy UI, payable journal foundation.
security_reliability_scalability: Prevent duplicate vendor invoice per supplier/tenant; preserve evidence and prohibit premature profit claims on incomplete cost.
acceptance_evidence: PO/GRN/bill mismatch visible for review.

implementation_steps: Build profile with multiple contact channels, tags, addresses, notes, source consent, interaction ledger and role-protected lookup; support anonymous POS walk-in.

security_reliability_scalability: Field-level PII visibility, exact tenant filters, masking and export audit; indexing/search limited by role.
acceptance_evidence: Cross-tenant search/merge test passes; counter sale does not require unnecessary PII.

contracts_data_ui: Customer alias/merge records, preview/confirm API and audit UI.
security_reliability_scalability: No auto merge from shared mobile number alone; disallow cross-tenant alias; review effects on payments/returns.
acceptance_evidence: All past orders retained and merged profile displays unified timeline.

implementation_steps: Capture channel, product interest, assignee, conversation notes, due date, NEW→CONTACTED→QUOTED→WON/LOST/EXPIRED stages and task linkage.
contracts_data_ui: `enquiries/activities`, stage commands, kanban/list and follow-up task.
security_reliability_scalability: Channel consent and attachment privacy, assignment by branch, no scraping/social API promises.
acceptance_evidence: Lost lead can reopen without duplicating customer; overdue follow-up becomes action.

implementation_steps: Draft quote with price/tax/shipping snapshot, validity, revisions and acceptance; convert to order command only after authoritative repricing and stock check.
contracts_data_ui: Quotations/lines and convert API; PDF/export preview if approved.
security_reliability_scalability: Quote itself does not hold stock; reject stale prices or report accepted override; duplicate conversion idempotent.
acceptance_evidence: Conversion never oversells and history shows accepted quote version.

implementation_steps: Create social session metadata and host; add product queue, assignee and customer booking timeline; close and report session.
contracts_data_ui: Social sessions/queue and fast-entry web/mobile UI; events.
security_reliability_scalability: Separate internal notes from external messages; employee attribution immutable; rate-limit booking storms.
acceptance_evidence: Two concurrent hosts on one SKU cannot confirm two holds.

feature: Social bookings, expiry and order handoff
implementation_steps: Create timed reservation, link customer and salesperson, optionally record payment request, convert hold to order allocation, or release on timeout/cancel.
contracts_data_ui: `social_bookings`, reservation source ref, conversion endpoint, expiry worker, mobile UI.
security_reliability_scalability: Expiry/convert interleaving uses compare-and-swap or row lock; worker replay cannot release consumed hold.
acceptance_evidence: SC-02 and SOC-AC1/2 pass under concurrency/retry.

implementation_steps: Model independent order/payment/fulfilment/shipment/return states and legal transitions; order header/lines snapshot price/tax/cost/customer/branch/channel/sales attribution.
contracts_data_ui: `orders/order_lines/status_history`, domain command handlers and order view.
security_reliability_scalability: Explicit version and line quantity invariants, unknown-state rejection, audit/outbox on confirmation.
acceptance_evidence: State model tests reject invalid transitions and report disputed cases.

feature: Manual/social order draft and server quote
implementation_steps: Start draft from customer/enquiry/quote/booking; validate line quantities, SKU visibility, branch price, discount authority, tax and availability; present recalculation.
contracts_data_ui: `POST /orders`, quote command, draft UI; no stock issue or invoice yet.
security_reliability_scalability: Tenant/branch scope and field allowlist; change quote price safely, no client-submitted paid/discount override.
acceptance_evidence: User edits draft; unavailable SKU yields explainable conflict without side effect.

implementation_steps: Confirm under COD/credit/paid policy, atomically consume compatible booking or create order allocation, dedupe confirm, freeze snapshots and emit event.
contracts_data_ui: Confirm endpoint, order allocation records, `order.confirmed`.
security_reliability_scalability: Confirm vs expiry and cancellation races tested with locking; never create two stock commitments; actor/attribution preserved.
acceptance_evidence: SC-02 conversion and repeated confirm create one committed order allocation.

implementation_steps: Generate per-line/location pick tasks, claim/assign, scan or manual verify, mark missing/damaged, reserve reallocation and update fulfilment status.
contracts_data_ui: `fulfillment_jobs/pick_tasks` and picker web/mobile view.
security_reliability_scalability: Branch-scoped pick permission, no stock decrement on view/pick per policy, optimistic task claim, fair worker processing.
acceptance_evidence: Two pickers cannot complete same qty twice; short pick leads exception.

implementation_steps: Pack verified lines into packages, generate manifest/label if configured, dispatch selected qty and post inventory issue once, preserve partial package history.
contracts_data_ui: `packages/shipments`, dispatch command, label stub, scan/status UI.
security_reliability_scalability: Atomic stock issue/source key and separate carrier external call; idempotent command replay; no dispatch beyond allocated/verified qty.
acceptance_evidence: Split parcels produce correct stock, fulfilment, shipment and usage prereqs.

feature: Shipping adapter, tracking and manual delivery
implementation_steps: Implement provider-neutral create/track/cancel interface, manual shipment fallback, verified inbound webhook, status normalization and proof-of-delivery reference.
contracts_data_ui: Carrier adapter, tracking_events, shipment timeline and operator-reconcile queue.
security_reliability_scalability: Raw payload redaction, HMAC validation, out-of-order mapping, provider timeouts/circuit breaker and no false delivered state.
acceptance_evidence: Failed provider call leaves shipment pending safely; replay maps once.

implementation_steps: Support shipments from selected locations, partial quantities, backorder blocked by default, outstanding remainder and partial delivery with stock/collection policy.
contracts_data_ui: `order_allocations`, multi-job fulfilment and UI outstanding quantities.
security_reliability_scalability: No double issue across locations or duplicate billable order count; cross-branch permissions for allocation.
acceptance_evidence: SC-03 partial dispatch and completion reconcile per line.

implementation_steps: Implement before-dispatch cancel, partial-line cancel, reserved-stock release, due recalculation and reason/approval; after-dispatch route to RTO or return.
contracts_data_ui: Cancellation commands, adjustment/credit note intents and timeline.
security_reliability_scalability: Race between dispatch and cancel resolves exactly one legal path; refund separate authority; no deleting order rows.
acceptance_evidence: Invalid after-dispatch cancellation rejected with actionable RTO option.

implementation_steps: Request RMA by eligible line/qty/window, authorize/reject, receive and inspect, disposition restock/quarantine/write-off, link refund/credit request.
contracts_data_ui: `return_authorizations/return_lines/inspection_results`, RMA UI and events.
security_reliability_scalability: Never return more than remaining eligible qty; damaged item not sellable; maker-checker for exceptions and partial returns.
acceptance_evidence: SC-06 damaged return does not inflate stock or refund twice.

implementation_steps: Model exchange as linked return and new commercial order plus net amount or store credit, record store-credit append-only entries, handle price difference and appropriate document corrections.
contracts_data_ui: `exchange_links/store_credit_entries`, exchange UI, payment/refund requests.
security_reliability_scalability: Credit redemption atomic, tenant/customer-bound, replay-safe; exchange may not count as new billable order without approved SaaS rule.
acceptance_evidence: Return, new SKU allocation and extra collection reconcile to customer balance.

feature: Failed delivery, RTO and carrier reconciliation

security_reliability_scalability: Do not mark customer paid from carrier promise; lost/RTO stock only returned after inspection/receipt.
acceptance_evidence: SC-06 separate RTO leaves settlement and stock accurate.

implementation_steps: Show who created, sold, discounted, confirmed, picked and collected, event history and adjustment reasons; preserve branch/source and share-basis salesperson attribution.
contracts_data_ui: Status/read projections, order activity API, permissioned view.
security_reliability_scalability: Guard private employee fields; eventual read model shows freshness; use cursor/indexed order feeds.
acceptance_evidence: Audit can reconstruct order and salesperson history after staff departure.

implementation_steps: Open register with opening float, bind cashier and branch, choose safe shift state, enforce only one valid active session where policy requires.
contracts_data_ui: Register/register_shifts, POS session endpoints and online connectivity UI.
security_reliability_scalability: Re-auth for sensitive void/close, branch permission, server-authoritative cash figures, no stock write while offline.
acceptance_evidence: Register opens/closes with independently reviewable shift records.

feature: POS cart, scan and counter pricing
implementation_steps: Scan/search SKU, build line basket, evaluate stock/branch prices, permitted discounts and customer optional; capture taxes/invoice mode before tender.

security_reliability_scalability: Offline cached availability is advisory only; concurrent last item must fail cleanly; discount override audited.
acceptance_evidence: Two cashiers contend for final SKU and only one counter sale commits.

feature: Mixed tender and POS order confirmation
implementation_steps: Accept cash, UPI, approved manual transfer, optional COD/credit policy; allocate tender amounts to order and issue receipt only after valid domain outcome.

security_reliability_scalability: Duplicate double-click/retry cannot create order/charge twice; client display never sets paid.
acceptance_evidence: SC-04 cash+UPI tender totals and stock reconcile.

contracts_data_ui: `payment_intents/attempts/collections`, payment screen and receipt linkage.
security_reliability_scalability: Forged screenshot/front-end response cannot set paid; unique external ref per provider account, source event signatures.
acceptance_evidence: SC-07 duplicate/delayed event leaves correct payment state.

implementation_steps: Allocate one or multiple verified collections to orders/returns/advances without exceeding source balance, track unapplied advance and outstanding invoices.
contracts_data_ui: `payment_allocations/customer_due_entries`, ledger views and balance summaries.
security_reliability_scalability: Serializable/locking policy for concurrent allocation; immutable journal and compensating reversal; no double allocation.
acceptance_evidence: Partial deposit followed by COD settlement yields explainable outstanding due.

contracts_data_ui: `settlements/settlement_lines/reconciliation_cases`, settlement workbench.
security_reliability_scalability: Provider data signed/authenticated and scoped by merchant account; batch imports idempotent; missing settlement cannot imply missing customer payment.
acceptance_evidence: Controlled mismatch produces one case and traceable resolution.

implementation_steps: Validate refund authorization versus remaining paid amount and return policy, execute provider/manual workflow, wait for authoritative outcome, record reversals/chargebacks.
contracts_data_ui: Refund requests/attempts, provider adapter, ledger adjustments, refund UI.
security_reliability_scalability: Maker-checker where policy requires, no arbitrary external-storefront refund endpoint; retries never pay twice.
acceptance_evidence: Duplicate refund request resolves original result and preserves audit.

feature: Cash movements, expenses and end-of-day close
implementation_steps: Record opening float, cash sales/refunds, deposits/withdrawals/expenses and counted closing cash; compare expected/actual, require variance approval.
contracts_data_ui: `cash_movements/expenses/register_shifts`, POS close and manager action.
